drafted_from: tool:read-a-page-in-arc's row in tools/read-a-page-in-arc/tool-rows.json, read-a-page-in-arc.mjs and test/read-a-page-in-arc.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read https://example.com/ in Arc." It opens the page in the browser you are signed in to, reads its title and visible text, and closes the tab.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: each run reads one page and answers it.
instructions: 1. Give one page address (http or https).
2. Say to your AI: "Read https://example.com/ in Arc." It calls tool:read-a-page-in-arc with the address.
3. Read the answer: title, address and text (at most 20000 characters), or error when Arc did not answer or the address is not http or https.

worked_examples.title: Read a public page in Arc
worked_examples.given: The public example page, titled Example Domain.
worked_examples.hands_back: title "Example Domain", address https://example.com/ and its visible text.
